sources.title: Empero on X: "Heard you on the naming. We've added -Distill to our Qwen3.8 models to make the lineage clear. They're under empero-ai/, not Qwen/, and the README always stated these are distillations, but the name should have too. Better conventions next time. Thanks for the nudge." / X
sources.snippet: Heard you on the naming. We've added -Distill to our Qwen3.8 models to make the lineage clear. They're under empero-ai/, not Qwen/, and the README always stated these are distillations, but the name should have too. Better conventions next time. Thanks for the nudge.
